newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold's Bompreco finalises SuperMar buy.
newsitem.headline: Ahold's Bompreco finalises SuperMar buy.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Monday its 50 percent owned Brazilian unit Bompreco SA Supermercados do Nordeste had finalised the buy of a controlling interest in the voting stock of SuperMar Supermercados SA in Brazil.
SuperMar is a regional supermarket company, operating in northeastern Brazil. The chain has 45 supermarkets, three hypermarkets and two discount department stores.

"The acquisition of SuperMar further strengthens Bompreco's position in the northeastern Brazil and increases total Bompreco food retail sales to over two billion dollars, ranking it the third largest supermarket company of Brazil," Ahold said in a statement.
"The addition to our joint operations will contribute to our growth in Brazil while the search for other joint-venture activities in South America continues," an Ahold spokesman was quoted as saying.
The deal, of which no financial deals were disclosed, had been announced at the beginning of March.
Bompreco said at the time it expected to announce a tender to acquire the remaining SuperMar shares after the deal had been finalised.
